**Visual Analysis of Test Image:**
- Looking down into the soybean canopy from above
- Lower/middle canopy leaves show yellow to brown spotting/discoloration
- Upper canopy leaves remain relatively green
- Angular yellow-brown lesions visible on lower leaves
- Defoliation pattern progressing from lower canopy upward

**Comparison to Septoria Brown Spot reference:**
- The reference shows identical angular red-brown spots with surrounding yellow halos on lower leaves
- Field-level pattern with lower canopy yellowing while upper remains green matches perfectly
- The bottom-right reference panel shows early-stage spots on lower leaves that closely match the test image lesions

The pattern of angular yellow-brown spots on lower leaves with upper canopy still green, and the progression from lower to middle canopy, is highly characteristic of Septoria brown spot.
